summary: Asked whether a vote could cost support, a member explains why they will stand by it.
realLife: owner, Nov 14: A member can answer a question about electoral risk by naming the principle behind a vote.
inGame: press-comment reads the vote and electorateSides for the underlying question.
gates: There is a recorded vote and evidence of electoral disagreement.

turns.what: The member explains the vote and leaves its effect on the next election open.
turns.pulledBy: No election or reliable measure of support has followed the vote.
turns.writesBack: The interview records the position without assigning an electoral loss.
